what: Access CDC Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System Data
title: Access CDC Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System Data
text: brfssdata gives R users direct, reproducible access annual microdata CDC Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS), largest continuously conducted health telephone survey world. Survey years processed compact parquet files hosted GitHub release assets. package downloads requested year single time local cache, queries DuckDB (pulling handful variables 300-plus column survey fast), hands back either tibble ready-made srvyr survey-design object correct weights, strata, primary sampling units survey era. Status: package infrastructure functional; first data releases prepared. brfss_years() reports survey years published moment.

title: Access CDC Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System Data
Access CDC Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System Data
text: Downloads cached brfss_cache_dir() (per tools::R_user_dir()), everything first pull works offline. brfss_cache_info() brfss_cache_clear() manage cache.
code: library(brfssdata)  # Which survey years are published? brfss_years()  # Respondent-level data, only the variables you need dat <- read_brfss(2019:2023, vars = c("GENHLTH", "PHYSHLTH", "_LLCPWT"))  # A survey-design object with era-correct weights, ready for srvyr library(srvyr) brfss_design(2023, vars = "GENHLTH") |>   group_by(GENHLTH) |>   summarize(prop = survey_prop(vartype = "ci"))  # Where does a variable appear across years? brfss_vars("smok")

what: Build a survey-design object for BRFSS analysis — brfss_design
title: Build a survey-design object for BRFSS analysis — brfss_design
text: Returns srvyr::as_survey_design() tbl_svy complex sampling design applied: primary sampling units (_PSU), strata (_STSTR), year-appropriate final weight. Weight selection automatic: _FINALWT years 2011 (post-stratification era) _LLCPWT 2011 (raking era). CDC states estimates 2011 onward directly comparable earlier years, 2011 added cell-phone-respondents replaced post-stratification raking. Requests pool years sides boundary therefore fail unless allow_break = TRUE set deliberately. several years combined, weights divided number years (pool_weights = TRUE, default) pooled estimates represent average year rather sum populations, variance strata become year--stratum interaction, treating annual survey independent sample.

title: Build a survey-design object for BRFSS analysis — brfss_design
code: brfss_design(   years,   vars = NULL,   allow_break = FALSE,   pool_weights = TRUE,   download = TRUE,   quiet = FALSE )

title: Build a survey-design object for BRFSS analysis — brfss_design
text: years Integer vector survey years, e.g. 2023 2019:2023. See brfss_years() available. vars Optional character vector analysis variables carry design. Design variables always included. allow_break Set TRUE permit pooling years across 2011 methodology change. warning still issued. pool_weights TRUE one year requested, divide weight number years. download FALSE, cached years used missing years raise error instead downloaded. quiet TRUE, suppress download progress output.

title: Build a survey-design object for BRFSS analysis — brfss_design
text: tbl_svy survey-design object. underlying data carry three added syntactic columns design built : brfss_wt (selected, possibly pooled, weight), brfss_psu, brfss_strata (raw stratum single year; year--stratum interaction years pooled). original CDC columns kept unchanged.

title: Build a survey-design object for BRFSS analysis — brfss_design
code: if (FALSE) { # interactive() library(srvyr) des <- brfss_design(2023, vars = "GENHLTH") des |>   group_by(GENHLTH) |>   summarize(prop = survey_prop()) }

title: brfssdata: Access CDC Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System Data — brfssdata-package
text: Download, cache, analyze annual microdata United States Centers Disease Control Prevention Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS) https://www.cdc.gov/brfss/. Survey years stored compact files hosted public releases queried lazily 'DuckDB' (via 'duckdb' package), requested years variables transferred. Survey-design helpers construct 'srvyr' design objects year-appropriate weights, strata, primary sampling units, including explicit handling 2011 weighting methodology change.

text: Returns respondent-level BRFSS data one survey years tibble. requested year downloaded local cache (see brfss_cache_dir()) read afterwards; query runs DuckDB, selecting handful variables 300-plus column survey stays fast. Different survey years carry different variable sets. years combined, variables absent year filled NA. year column always identifies survey year row.

Use brfss_vars() search names across years. download FALSE, cached years used missing years raise error instead downloaded. quiet TRUE, suppress download progress output.
